title: chasmanthium laxum subsp. sessiliflorum
intro: Chasmanthium laxum subsp. sessiliflorum, commonly known as Indian grass, is a type of ornamental grass native to the United States. It is known for its delicate, drooping flowers and slender foliage, making it a popular choice for landscaping and gardening. The health benefits of Indian grass include its potential to reduce inflammation and alleviate stress, although more research is needed to confirm these effects. The plant's bioactive constituents include sesquiterpenes and flavonoids, which have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
